correctness.rationale: Let the 16 graph vertices be even-parity five-bit masks, with edges when XOR weight is four; this is the 5-regular folded five-cube with exactly 40 edges. Ind_2 consists exactly of subsets whose induced degrees are <=1 (every connected component at most two vertices). Fresh complete enumeration of 65,535 nonempty masks produced exactly 2,142 faces with f=(16,120,400,660,576,280,80,10). Independently reconstructed sequential 16-vertex toggle pairing gave 1,070 pairs and precisely two critical simplices (a 0-cell and a 4-cell); complete 9,280-incidence reversed-Hasse topological sort visited all 2,142 faces, establishing a Morse CW model S4, not just its homology. Even-bit translations and permutations of five coordinates act faithfully, giving subgroup T⋊S5 of size 16×120=1920. A graph automorphism fixing zero injects into permutations of its five weight-four neighbors since other vertices are uniquely specified by common-neighbor patterns, so this is the full group. Fresh independent signed invariant-face Lefschetz calculations for every one of all 1,920 automorphisms obtained degree sgn(permutation) on top integral H4 (960 positive, 960 negative). This is a statement about H4 as an integral rank-one character, not an equivariant S4 homotopy equivalence.
residual_risks: The graph convention is the 5-regular Clebsch, not its 10-regular complement.
Only this graph and the two-independence functor are classified; no claim for all strongly regular/folded hypercubes.

value.rationale: The 5-regular Clebsch/folded-five-cube graph is a canonical small nonchordal strongly regular graph, outside available general Ind_2 graph families. Determining its nonpure eight-dimensional face complex is nonetheless homotopy S4 and identifying its full 1920-element affine orientation character is a motivated exact invariant: neither follows from ordinary independent-set homology or abstract group order. The result is bounded to one naturally selected graph and functor, consistent with an exact self-contained classification.
residual_risks: No extension claimed to other folded hypercubes or equivariant homotopy.
